Name: ValleyRecap
Author: h4790
Description:
# Valley Recap

Valley Recap keeps a lightweight daily history of your farm.

After each completed day, it records:

- wallet changes during the day;
- estimated shipping-bin income;
- the three most valuable shipped item types;
- skill-level increases;
- friendship-point increases.

The previous day's summary appears the next morning. Press F8 to open the recent seven-day journal.

## Installation

1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.
2. Extract the ValleyRecap folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Play and complete one full day.
5. Press F8 to view the journal.

## Configuration

A config.json file is created after the first launch.

You can change:

- the journal hotkey;
- whether the morning recap is shown;
- the number of displayed days;
- the maximum history length.

## Compatibility

- Built for Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ and SMAPI 4.x.
- Tested on Windows with SMAPI 4.5.2.
- Single-player has been tested.
- Multiplayer has not yet been fully verified.
- No Harmony patches are used.
- Safe to add or remove from an existing save.

## Uninstall

Delete the ValleyRecap folder from your Mods directory.

The mod does not modify vanilla maps, items, NPCs or save structures.

## AI disclosure

AI-assisted tools were used during code development. The result was manually compiled and tested in-game. The mod contains no generated artwork, dialogue, voices or redistributed game assets.
